text: Baan Noi charges about 22 dollars a head, which feels fair considering what you get. Order the pad see ew. It's got proper texture and the noodles actually taste like something. Don't bother with the green curry, they load it up with sugar and it ends up really cloying. That wasn't the only thing that dragged the meal down. We went in on Friday and the wait was long. It's clear the kitchen was in over its head. You can get a decent meal going here, but you have to put up with slow service. And I think you can get similar results at a bunch of other places around town. Getting the bad is too easy and the good is just too easy elsewhere. I'd rather eat somewhere that gets both right.
